intervention: Before is exact v2 after snapshot. After replaces only verification-rules.md. Both receive identical frozen approved scenario facts without a handoff reminder.
decision_rule: DIRECTIONAL_SIGNAL requires packet credit after >=3/4 and strictly above before, with no per-case decline. Every approved scenario field and exact arm V1 section, with only the preregistered terminal-LF boundary allowance, must occur in actual spawn prompt, bound to that receiver completed PASS verdict. Every candidate must be clean 3/3, refactor green, zero P0, no timeout, no unapproved scope writes, and causally detect DOM/sync/disabled faults. Baseline packet omissions are treatment outcomes, not guard failures. Missing or unverifiable evidence fails closed.
approved_runtime_paths: Path-and-config runtime classification: .playwright-cli/page-YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS-mmmZ.yml; test-results/.last-run.json; test-results/<single safe slug>/{trace.zip,error-context.md}. Runtime paths are separately listed, not product writes. Every other non-tests path fails scope.
common_prompt_appendix: For BOTH arms, standard timestamped .playwright-cli/page-YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS-mmmZ.yml snapshots and the configured trace-on Playwright test-results/.last-run.json plus test-results/<single safe slug>/trace.zip or error-context.md are approved runtime output paths. List these separately from generated test files; they are not product writes. All other non-tests workspace paths remain unapproved. Runtime classification is based on these exact path families and the frozen fixture configuration, independently of transcript command formatting.
limits: Two correlated constructed fixtures; two repetitions each, not independent defects.
Packet handoff is primary; browser causal kill is a regression guard.
No release equivalence, generalization, significance or cost claim.
Eight calls total; no retries. Missing cells are INCOMPLETE.
Prospective v6 changes correlated case render labels and delay. V5 posthoc boundary replay is calibration only; frozen v5 outcome remains unchanged and no earlier model calls are pooled.
packet_section_boundary: Accept the original exact V1 section anywhere in the outgoing packet, or that section with exactly ONE terminal LF removed ONLY when the remaining section ends at end-of-message. No internal normalization, header/list changes, truncation or other whitespace edits.
